title: Transition (edge)
description: One behaviour applied between two surfaces. In the ABM a transition is an EDGE of the behaviour graph, not a record of a tool call: there is exactly one entry per (from_state, behavior, to_state), however many DOM steps the behaviour took to get there. The steps live in behavior.realization[]; the edge is what the application did, in domain terms.

from_state.description: Source surface. A single concrete state: an edge is one pairing, so a behaviour offered from several surfaces is several edges. Wildcards and state lists are not part of the ABM.

to_state.description: Destination surface. May equal from_state for a self-loop (re-render, retry, validation failure).

behavior.description: The behaviour an actor asked for. This is the edge's identity alongside from_state and to_state.

arguments.description: Concrete argument values this edge was traversed with, e.g. {coupon_code: 'SAVE10'}. A journey step may bind different values for its own walk.

target.description: Element the actor acted on, when the behaviour is not bound to a single element.

guard.description: Condition that must hold for this transition to be taken, e.g. cart.item_count > 0.

effects.description: What changed as a result. Prefer semantic paths (order.total) over DOM selectors.

assertions.description: Checks that should hold after this transition, used when generating a test step.

evidence.description: Every edge must carry the three roles separately, because they answer three different questions and the collapse of steps into an edge destroys any other way to tell them apart: 'identity' shows why this is the right from_state, 'action' shows which realization step actually caused the move (the causal step is otherwise unrecoverable), and 'effect' shows why this is the right to_state.

effect.description: An observed or inferred consequence of a transition. Required fields depend on `type`.

type.description: value_changed: a semantic value differs. visibility_changed: element shown/hidden/enabled/disabled. navigation: a page was entered. url_changed: URL mutated without navigation. state_entered: graph state entered. message: user-facing feedback. request: an API call happened. storage_changed: cookie/localStorage/session. validation_error: input rejected. element_created/element_destroyed: DOM-level evidence of a structural change. list_changed: collection membership/order changed.

target.description: Semantic path (order.total), element id (element_cart_badge) or storage key.

from.description: Value before the transition. Omit when unknown.

value.description: Value for effects that have no 'before', e.g. message text.

observed.description: true when the effect was seen in evidence, false when it was inferred from code. Inferred effects must carry confidence in metadata.
